answer.reason: The verses tell of Mordecai's deeds in the story of Haman's plot and his own rise, so a line of four clauses is warranted.

clauses.english: exposed a plot of two chamberlains against the king
clauses.quote: sought to lay hands on the king Ahasuerus
But Mordecai bowed not, nor did him reverence.

clauses.english: was honoured by the king and led on horseback through the city
clauses.quote: brought him on horseback through the street of the city

clauses.english: wrote to all the Jews to keep two days of feasting each year
clauses.quote: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews
